profile.org_note: Family-owned and family-run with no published titles: the company site says the founders' four sons (Scot, Todd, Dennis and Fritz Olthof) and grandson Matt each manage a different part of the business. Two offices: St. John (home office and Northwest Indiana) and Carmel (Indianapolis division under a division manager). Land offers go to one published contact (jlenehan@olthofhomes.com); entitlement and land-development work in Northwest Indiana is presented to towns by Kevin Paszko and Jeff Yatsko. No finance officer is named anywhere public. Corporate office line for trade partners: 219-558-8080.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @olthofhomes.com (single published example: jlenehan@olthofhomes.com)
profile.summary: Private, three-generation family builder founded in 1961 and based in St. John, Indiana. Sells single-family homes, paired villas and townhomes in about 20 communities, all in Indiana, split between Northwest Indiana and the Indianapolis area (entered 2017); it opened five new communities in 2026 and says it wants to be a top-50 US builder. A conventional for-sale builder that develops much of its own land through affiliated LLCs and asks landowners to sell to it directly.
